pca.caption: PCA of the 500 most variable features on blind variance-stabilized counts. Features are centered, not variance-scaled. Each point is one biological sample. No sample was removed by PCA.

sample_correlation.caption: Pearson correlations across all 19235 finite, variable features on blind variance-stabilized counts; fixed color limits from -1 to 1.

sample_qc.caption: Left: distributions of the analysis values, with extreme boxplot points omitted only from this display. Right: sample-level assay quality summaries. All biological samples are retained; individual samples are identified by name.

ma.caption: Mean normalized counts versus apeGLM-style shrunken log2 fold change. Orange triangles: BH-adjusted Wald p < 0.05; gray circles: all other retained genes, including genes without adjusted p values. Significance is derived from the preserved unshrunken Wald test.

volcano.caption: Each point is one retained gene with a finite Wald p value; x: unshrunken model coefficient, y: unadjusted Wald p value. Orange triangles indicate BH-adjusted p < 0.05; gray circles denote the remaining genes. Labels identify the top three adjusted-p-value ranked rows; no horizontal nominal-p cutoff is used to imply multiplicity-adjusted significance.

top30_heatmap.caption: Top 30 features ranked by adjusted Wald p value, then nominal p value (PM versus PBS); rows are centered and scaled by their sample standard deviation for display only. Selection is descriptive and is not independent validation. Fixed sample order; no clustering of samples.
